readings.Aries: Bold moves suit you. Impulsive ones have a different outcome — know which this is. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Taurus: What feels like stability might be stagnation. It is worth sitting with the discomfort of not knowing. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Gemini: You process everything through language. Today, there is something language can't quite reach. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Cancer: Your sensitivity is precision, not weakness. The readings it gives are accurate. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Leo: You are at your best when you have something to offer. Today, what are you offering? What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Virgo: Your standards are high because you know what's possible. Most people don't. This is lonely sometimes. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Libra: The thing you've been putting off deciding has already been decided by your inaction. Notice this. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Scorpio: The control you maintain over your environment is good and occasionally excessive. Today: excessive. The first instinct was right.
readings.Sagittarius: The question you're asking is good. The answer you're expecting is limiting the search. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Capricorn: There's a version of rest you can access without losing anything. Find it. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Aquarius: The paradox you've been carrying is that you believe in human connection and maintain great distance from it. Close some. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Pisces: Your perception of what someone needs is often more accurate than their perception of what they need. Use this gently. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
